job_summary: The Backend Software Engineer will design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs, collaborating with frontend, product, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable cloud-native applications. Key responsibilities include developing scalable backend APIs, optimizing databases, writing clean code, deploying and monitoring cloud services. The role requires experience with Python, FastAPI/Django/Flask, SQL (PostgreSQL/MySQL), Git, Docker, OOP, Data Structures & Algorithms, and strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. Preferred skills include AWS/Azure, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Microservices.
